Exhibit index

This page records provenance for artifacts referenced in the filed court documents. Each exhibit has a stable URL so a filing or letter can cite it directly. The index describes what each artifact is and what it shows on its face. It does not characterise anyone: allegations belong in filed pleadings, where they are adjudicated.

What the exhibits establish

A screenshot shows that an account published something. On its own it does not show who operates that account, and it does not show what that person owns or runs. Those are separate questions with separate evidence, so they are set out separately below. Where this archive holds nothing supporting a step, it says so.

Public contact between the accounts @adezero and @JustCallMeJoeP

What the exhibits establish about public exchanges between the two accounts.

  1. The accounts @adezero and @JustCallMeJoeP exchanged public posts in March 2026.

    Supported by exhibits in this archive.

    Supporting exhibits: EX-09, EX-10, EX-11, EX-08

    • The exchanges are public posts. This archive holds no direct messages and makes no claim about any communication not published publicly.
    • No exhibit carries an independent third-party archive reference, and none can be made: the source account has been suspended and the posts are no longer live. The screenshots are the record this archive holds. Authenticated platform records would be stronger evidence than either a screenshot or a third-party crawl.

  2. The X account @adezero is operated by the plaintiff in these matters.

    Asserted in filed pleadings, which are linked. Filed allegations are allegations until adjudicated.

    This archive does not independently establish who operates the account. The association is asserted in filed pleadings, which are indexed under the case pages. Filed allegations are allegations until adjudicated.

    No exhibit in this archive supports this step.

The X account @JustCallMeJoeP

What the exhibits establish about the account @JustCallMeJoeP, link by link.

  1. The X account @JustCallMeJoeP published the posts reproduced in these exhibits.

    Supported by exhibits in this archive.

    Supporting exhibits: EX-01, EX-03, EX-04, EX-06, EX-07, EX-12

    • Four further exhibits are filed under names implying this account but have the posting account's name and handle cropped out of the capture. They are listed on their own exhibit pages with that limitation recorded, and they are not counted as support for this link.
    • No exhibit carries an independent third-party archive reference, and none can be made: the source account has been suspended and the posts are no longer live. The screenshots are the record this archive holds. Authenticated platform records would be stronger evidence than either a screenshot or a third-party crawl.

  2. The X account @JustCallMeJoeP is operated by a specific, legally identifiable individual.

    Supported only by a statement the account made about itself. Self-description is not independent identification.

    In the May 26 2026 thread the account gives its own name as "Joseph E. Prichardington the 3rd" and applies the word "Nazzy" to itself. Both are statements the account published about itself. A self-description is not independent identification, and "Joseph E. Prichardington the 3rd" is not a name this archive has matched to any record. No exhibit here identifies the operator by legal name.

    Supporting exhibits: EX-12

    • The account's display name and the name it gives for itself are different strings, and neither has been corroborated against any public record in this archive.

  3. The operator of @JustCallMeJoeP owns or operates a named business.

    No exhibit in this archive supports this step.

    No exhibit in this archive connects this account, or any name associated with it, to any business. This link is unsupported by the material collected here.

    No exhibit in this archive supports this step.
